//===== Ragnarok Offline =====================================
//= Black-Market Armor Seller
//= Mordain offers body armor in Equipment and Specialty catalogs.
//= Browse each catalog by 0-9 or A-Z.
//============================================================

paramk,37,163,2	script	Mordain#offline	4_EP21_GALAXIA_A,{
	mes "[Mordain]";
	mes "Body armor, sorted for the discerning knight.";
	.@cat = select("Equipment:Specialty:") - 1;
	.@letter = -1;
	.@shop$ = "";
	if (.@cat == 0) {
		.@letter = select("A:B:C:D:E:F:G:H:I:J:K:L:M:N:O:P:R:S:T:U:V:W:Y:") - 1;
		if (.@letter == 0) .@shop$ = "arm0#A";
		if (.@letter == 1) .@shop$ = "arm0#B";
		if (.@letter == 2) .@shop$ = "arm0#C";
		if (.@letter == 3) .@shop$ = "arm0#D";
		if (.@letter == 4) .@shop$ = "arm0#E";
		if (.@letter == 5) .@shop$ = "arm0#F";
		if (.@letter == 6) .@shop$ = "arm0#G";
		if (.@letter == 7) .@shop$ = "arm0#H";
		if (.@letter == 8) .@shop$ = "arm0#I";
		if (.@letter == 9) .@shop$ = "arm0#J";
		if (.@letter == 10) .@shop$ = "arm0#K";
		if (.@letter == 11) .@shop$ = "arm0#L";
		if (.@letter == 12) .@shop$ = "arm0#M";
		if (.@letter == 13) .@shop$ = "arm0#N";
		if (.@letter == 14) .@shop$ = "arm0#O";
		if (.@letter == 15) .@shop$ = "arm0#P";
		if (.@letter == 16) .@shop$ = "arm0#R";
		if (.@letter == 17) .@shop$ = "arm0#S";
		if (.@letter == 18) .@shop$ = "arm0#T";
		if (.@letter == 19) .@shop$ = "arm0#U";
		if (.@letter == 20) .@shop$ = "arm0#V";
		if (.@letter == 21) .@shop$ = "arm0#W";
		if (.@letter == 22) .@shop$ = "arm0#Y";
	}
	if (.@cat == 1) {
		.@letter = select("A:D:G:I:K:N:S:U:") - 1;
		if (.@letter == 0) .@shop$ = "arm1#A";
		if (.@letter == 1) .@shop$ = "arm1#D";
		if (.@letter == 2) .@shop$ = "arm1#G";
		if (.@letter == 3) .@shop$ = "arm1#I";
		if (.@letter == 4) .@shop$ = "arm1#K";
		if (.@letter == 5) .@shop$ = "arm1#N";
		if (.@letter == 6) .@shop$ = "arm1#S";
		if (.@letter == 7) .@shop$ = "arm1#U";
	}
	if (.@shop$ == "") { close; }
	close2;
	callshop .@shop$, 1;
	end;

OnInit:
	setunittitle(getnpcid(0), "<Dark Knight>");
	end;
}
